alternatives: what is lacking in Christ's afflictions
decisions.reason: Readable states the sense chosen in m2, which is uncertain.

decisions.choice: the task God gave me (B); God gave me the work (R)
decisions.reason: The plain sense of the household word (m4).

decisions.choice: mystery: God's plan, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} kept hidden
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "mystery", as Literal and Balanced do and as Ephesians does at every level, so the word stays the same wherever Paul uses it. Because in current English "mystery" can suggest a puzzle, Readable says at once what this mystery is: God's plan, once hidden and now made known (m6).

decisions.choice: people who are not Jews
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Gentiles" (m9).

decisions.choice: misterio, explained as "un secreto"
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "secret". Spanish keeps "misterio" at every level, since it is the word Spanish readers meet in the rest of Paul (Romans 16:25; Ephesians 3:3), and Readable explains it once with "un secreto que Dios tuvo escondido" (m6).

decisions.choice: mayordomía
decisions.reason: "Mayordomía" is the office of a household steward, the picture in οἰκονομίαν (m4). "Dispensación" now suggests a theological system. Balanced and Readable say "la tarea" (the task), as the English does.

decisions.choice: mystère at every level, Readable included (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in English, the key word stays the same wherever Paul uses it (2:2, 4:3). French "mystère" can suggest something that cannot be understood, so Readable says at once what it is here: "le plan de Dieu", once hidden and now made known (m6).

decisions.choice: les nations (L, B); les peuples qui ne sont pas juifs (R)
decisions.reason: "Les Gentils" is no longer current French, and "les païens" today suggests people with no religion or a pejorative judgment. "Les nations" keeps the biblical sense of the peoples other than Israel (m9); Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: siri at every level
decisions.reason: Swahili has one ordinary word, "siri", for both a secret and a mystery, so all three levels say "siri" and Readable needs no change of word, unlike the English. "Fumbo" is a riddle or puzzle, the sense m6 rules out. Use "siri" for μυστήριον throughout Paul.

decisions.choice: mateso (παθήμασιν); taabu (θλίψεων)
decisions.reason: The two Greek words are kept apart: "mateso" for Paul's sufferings, "taabu" (hardships, troubles) for the afflictions still to be borne, which fits m2: hardships, not Christ's atoning death.

decisions.choice: "sự mầu nhiệm" for mystery at every level; Readable adds "kế hoạch của Đức Chúa Trời"
decisions.reason: "Mầu nhiệm" is the Vietnamese church word for a divine secret now revealed (m6) and is kept as the key term wherever Paul uses it, as the English keeps "mystery". "Điều bí mật" would suggest something still kept secret; Readable explains the word instead of replacing it.

decisions.choice: "các dân ngoại" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Dân ngoại" is the established word for the peoples other than Israel (m9); "các dân tộc" would lose that contrast. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "비밀" for the mystery at every level, Readable included ("비밀, 곧 하나님의 계획")
decisions.reason: Key term: God's purpose, hidden until he makes it known. "비밀" (a secret) says exactly that and is the word Korean Protestant readers know in this sense; "신비" suggests something beyond understanding. Readable keeps the word and explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "내 차례로 채우고" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb has a prefix meaning "in turn": Paul takes up his own share of what remains. Literal shows it with "내 차례로"; Balanced and Readable say it with "채워 가고" and "겪고 있습니다".

decisions.choice: o mistério (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. "Mistério" keeps the same word wherever Paul uses it (2:2; 4:3), as the English does at every level; Readable explains it at once as "o plano de Deus" (m6), so it is not read as a puzzle.

decisions.choice: as nações (L); os não judeus (B); as pessoas que não são judias (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the style guide sets it: Literal says "as nações", Balanced "os não judeus" (no hyphen, 1990 spelling), Readable explains it as the English does (m9). "Gentios" is church language few readers use.

source.text: ὃν ἡμεῖς καταγγέλλομεν νουθετοῦντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ διδάσκοντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ, ἵνα παραστήσωμεν πάντα ἄνθρωπον τέλειον ἐν Χριστῷ·

records.literal_gloss: whom we proclaim, warning every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that we may present every man complete in Christ;

en.L: Him we proclaim, warning every {{gender:person|man}} and teaching every {{gender:person|man}} in all wisdom, so that we may present every {{gender:person|man}} complete in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} is the one we proclaim. We warn {{gender:every person|every man}} and teach {{gender:every person|every man}} with all wisdom, so that we may bring {{gender:every person|every man}} before God mature in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} is the one we tell people about. We warn and teach {{gender:every person|every man}}, using all the wisdom God gives. We want to bring {{gender:every person|every man}} to God as a mature believer who belongs to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: A {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} anunciamos nosotros, amonestando a {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} y enseñando a {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} en toda sabiduría, a fin de presentar a {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} completo en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} es aquel a quien anunciamos. Amonestamos a {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} y enseñamos a {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} con toda sabiduría, para presentar ante Dios a {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} maduro en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} es aquel de quien hablamos a la gente. Advertimos y enseñamos a {{gender:cada persona|cada hombre}}, usando toda la sabiduría que Dios da. Queremos llevar a {{gender:cada persona|cada hombre}} ante Dios con una fe madura, como alguien que pertenece {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}.

fr.L: Lui, nous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}annonçons, avertissant {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} et enseignant {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} en toute sagesse, afin de présenter {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} accompli {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}.
fr.B: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que nous annonçons. Nous avertissons {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} et nous instruisons {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} en toute sagesse, afin d’amener devant Dieu {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} parvenu à la maturité {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}.
fr.R: Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, c’est de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que nous parlons aux gens. Nous avertissons et nous enseignons {{gender:tout le monde|tout homme}}, avec toute la sagesse que Dieu donne. Nous voulons que {{gender:tout le monde|tout homme}} arrive devant Dieu avec une foi adulte, uni au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

sw.L: Yeye tunamtangaza sisi, tukimwonya kila mtu na tukimfundisha kila mtu kwa hekima yote, ili tumsimamishe kila mtu akiwa amekamilika katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ndiye tunayemtangaza. Tunamwonya kila mtu na kumfundisha kila mtu kwa hekima yote, ili tumsimamishe kila mtu mbele za Mungu akiwa amekomaa katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ndiye tunayewaeleza watu habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. Tunamwonya na kumfundisha kila mtu, tukitumia hekima yote ambayo Mungu hutoa. Tunataka kumleta kila mtu kwa Mungu akiwa mwamini aliyekomaa, aliye wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

vi.L: Ngài là Đấng chúng tôi rao giảng, khuyên răn mọi người và dạy dỗ mọi người trong mọi sự khôn ngoan, để chúng tôi trình diện mọi người trở nên trọn vẹn trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là Đấng mà chúng tôi rao giảng. Chúng tôi khuyên răn mọi người và dạy dỗ mọi người với tất cả sự khôn ngoan, để đem mọi người đến trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời, trưởng thành trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là Đấng chúng tôi rao truyền cho mọi người. Chúng tôi khuyên răn và dạy dỗ từng người, dùng mọi sự khôn ngoan Đức Chúa Trời ban cho. Chúng tôi muốn đem mỗi người đến với Đức Chúa Trời như một tín hữu trưởng thành thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

ko.L: 우리는 그분을 전하며, 모든 사람을 깨우치고 모든 사람을 모든 지혜로 가르칩니다. 이는 모든 사람을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 완전한 사람으로 세우려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 전하는 분은 바로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다. 우리는 모든 지혜를 다해 모든 사람을 깨우치고 모든 사람을 가르칩니다. 모든 사람을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 성숙한 사람으로 하나님 앞에 세우려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리가 사람들에게 전하는 분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다. 우리는 하나님께서 주시는 모든 지혜를 써서 모든 사람을 깨우치고 가르칩니다. 우리는 모든 사람이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속한 성숙한 신자가 되어 하나님 앞에 서게 되기를 바랍니다.

pt.L: A {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nós anunciamos, advertindo {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} e ensinando {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} em toda sabedoria, a fim de apresentarmos {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} completo {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}.
pt.B: É {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} que nós anunciamos. Advertimos {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} e ensinamos {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} com toda a sabedoria, para apresentarmos diante de Deus {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} maduro {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}}.
pt.R: É {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} que falamos às pessoas. Nós advertimos e ensinamos {{gender:cada pessoa|cada homem}}, usando toda a sabedoria que Deus dá. Queremos levar {{gender:cada pessoa|cada homem}} até Deus como alguém maduro na fé, que pertence {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}.

decisions.choice: whom: Christ, named at the end of verse 27
decisions.reason: ὃν picks up "Christ in you". The message Paul proclaims is a person.

decisions.choice: every person, without exception
decisions.reason: πάντα ἄνθρωπον is said three times. The noun means a human being, man or woman. The repetition stresses that the wisdom of the gospel is for every believer, not kept for a few.

decisions.choice: warning and teaching: correcting what is wrong and instructing in what is right
decisions.reason: νουθετέω means to set someone's mind right by warning; διδάσκω is to teach. Believers are to do the same for one another (3:16).

decisions.choice: complete, mature: grown to full stature in Christ, not sinless
decisions.reason: τέλειον describes what has reached its goal: full-grown, complete (1 Corinthians 14:20; Philippians 3:15). The picture is the day when believers are presented to God (compare verse 22).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "in Christ"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "Jesus". The meaning is not changed.

decisions.choice: every {{gender:person|man}} (L); {{gender:every person|every man}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, so the default is inclusive; "every man" is the traditional form.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is the one we proclaim; before God (B), to God (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Christ for "whom" and say to whom believers are presented (as in verse 22).

decisions.choice: using all the wisdom God gives
decisions.reason: Readable says where the wisdom comes from (compare verse 9), so that it is not taken for Paul's own cleverness.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todo ser humano|todo hombre}} (L, B); {{gender:cada persona|cada hombre}} (R)
decisions.reason: Unlike "hermanos" in verse 2, ἄνθρωπον is a human being, and Spanish "todo hombre" is often read as male, so the inclusive form is the default, as in John 1:9. Readable says "con una fe madura" so that the sentence does not need a masculine adjective.

decisions.choice: {{gender:tout être humain|tout homme}} (L, B); {{gender:tout le monde|tout homme}} (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a human being, man or woman (m2). "Chaque personne" would make the words that agree with it feminine ("parvenue", "unie") in the default but not in the alternative; "tout être humain" and "tout le monde" agree like "tout homme", so only the noun changes.

decisions.choice: accompli (L); parvenu à la maturité (B); avec une foi adulte (R)
decisions.reason: "Parfait" would suggest without fault, which the meaning decision rules out (m4); as in Hebrews, "accompli" is used for people who have reached their goal.

decisions.choice: "mọi người" (L, B), "từng người", "mỗi người" (R), with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người" is a human being of either sex, so there is no second, traditional wording for the gender setting to offer (as in John 1:4).

decisions.choice: "모든 사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "every person" or "every man" for a word meaning a human being. Korean "사람" already means a human being of either sex and has no generic masculine to offer, so the gender setting has nothing to change here, or in "사람들" elsewhere in the letter.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todo ser humano|todo homem}} (L, B); {{gender:cada pessoa|cada homem}} (R)
decisions.reason: The English default is "every person". Portuguese "pessoa" is feminine, and the adjective after it ("completo", "maduro") would have to change with the setting; "todo ser humano" is just as inclusive and masculine like "todo homem", so the sentence reads the same either way. Readable, where "alguém" takes the adjective, can say "cada pessoa".

source.text: εἰς ὃ καὶ κοπιῶ ἀγωνιζόμενος κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν δυνάμει.

records.literal_gloss: for which also I toil, struggling according to the working of him, the [one] working in me in power.

en.L: For this I also toil, struggling according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} working, which is at work in me in power.
en.B: This is the goal I toil for, struggling by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} energy, which is powerfully at work in me.
en.R: That is why I work so hard and keep on struggling. But I do it with the energy {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gives me: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty power is at work in me.

es.L: Para esto también me fatigo, luchando según {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obrar, que obra en mí con poder.
es.B: Por esta meta trabajo hasta cansarme, luchando con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} energía, que actúa poderosamente en mí.
es.R: Por eso trabajo tanto y sigo luchando. Pero lo hago con la energía que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} me da: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran poder está actuando en mí.

fr.L: C’est pour cela aussi que je peine, luttant selon {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} opération qui opère en moi avec puissance.
fr.B: C’est le but pour lequel je peine et je lutte, avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} énergie qui agit puissamment en moi.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que je travaille si dur et que je continue à lutter. Mais je le fais avec l’énergie que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} me donne : {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande puissance agit en moi.

sw.L: Kwa hilo pia ninafanya kazi kwa bidii hadi kuchoka, nikipambana kufuatana na utendaji {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unaotenda ndani yangu kwa uweza.
sw.B: Hilo ndilo lengo ninalolitaabikia, nikipambana kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zinazofanya kazi ndani yangu kwa uweza mkubwa.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu ninafanya kazi kwa bidii na kuendelea kupambana. Lakini ninafanya hivyo kwa nguvu anazonipa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}: uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mkuu unafanya kazi ndani yangu.

vi.L: Vì mục đích đó tôi cũng lao nhọc, gắng sức chiến đấu theo năng lực hành động của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là năng lực đang hành động trong tôi với quyền năng.
vi.B: Đó là mục tiêu tôi lao nhọc, gắng sức chiến đấu bằng năng lực của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là năng lực đang hành động mạnh mẽ trong tôi.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi làm việc khó nhọc và không ngừng phấn đấu. Nhưng tôi làm điều đó bằng năng lực mà {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ban cho tôi: quyền năng lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang hành động trong tôi.

ko.L: 이 일을 위하여 나도, 내 안에서 능력으로 일하시는 그분의 일하심을 따라 애쓰며 수고합니다.
ko.B: 이 목표를 위해 나는 수고하며 애쓰고 있습니다. 내 안에서 힘 있게 일하시는 그분의 힘으로 애씁니다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 그렇게 열심히 일하고 계속 애씁니다. 그러나 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 주시는 힘으로 그 일을 합니다. 그분의 큰 능력이 내 안에서 일하고 있습니다.

pt.L: Para isso também trabalho duro, lutando segundo a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} atuação, que atua em mim com poder.
pt.B: Esse é o objetivo pelo qual me esforço, lutando com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} energia, que age poderosamente em mim.
pt.R: É por isso que trabalho tanto e continuo lutando. Mas faço isso com a energia que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} me dá: o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} grande poder age em mim.

decisions.choice: for this: to present every person mature in Christ (verse 28)
decisions.reason: εἰς ὃ ("to which") points back to the goal at the end of verse 28.

decisions.choice: toil and struggle: hard labor, like an athlete straining in a contest
decisions.reason: κοπιάω is work to the point of weariness. ἀγωνίζομαι is the word for competing in the games, and Paul goes on with the related noun in 2:1. His struggle includes prayer (compare 4:12) and imprisonment (4:18).

decisions.choice: his working: the working of Christ, named in verse 28
decisions.reason: αὐτοῦ most naturally refers to Christ, the last person named. In 2:12 the same word is used for the working of God, who raised Christ; the power is God's, at work through Christ.

decisions.choice: a play on words: the working that works in me
decisions.reason: ἐνέργειαν and ἐνεργουμένην come from the same root, as if "his energy energizing in me". The form ἐνεργουμένην means it is at work by its own power. Paul's effort is real, but the power is not his own.

decisions.choice: the energy {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gives me
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ for "his" (m3).

decisions.choice: energy
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the sense of power at work; Literal keeps "working" to show the play on words (m4).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obrar, que obra
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the play on words in ἐνέργειαν ... ἐνεργουμένην (m4) by using the same Spanish root twice.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} opération qui opère (L); énergie (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the play on words of a noun and a verb from the same root (m4), which French can show only with "opération ... opère". Balanced and Readable say "énergie", the plain sense.

decisions.choice: utendaji wake unaotenda
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the play on words (m4) with the noun and verb from one root, "utendaji" and "-tenda". Balanced and Readable say "nguvu" (strength, energy), as the English Balanced says "energy".

decisions.choice: "năng lực hành động ... năng lực đang hành động" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal repeats the words to show the play on words of m4, the working that works in him.

decisions.choice: "일하시는 그분의 일하심" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the play on words in the meaning decision, a noun and a verb from one root, with the native "일하다" and its noun "일하심". "역사" in this sense is church language that many readers no longer understand. The same noun, God's working, is "일하심" in 2:12.

decisions.choice: a sua atuação, que atua
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the play on words of m4 with one Portuguese root, as the English Literal says "working, which is at work". "Operação" now sounds technical or medical.
